So fun to do DealBook with my friend and partner of 11 years, @gdb. Thrilled the world got to see the brilliant, fiercely determined leader I have the privilege of working with every day.

Greg’s role at OpenAI has evolved from writing code 100 hours a week in the early days to now leading some of the hardest and most consequential parts of our business.

One thing that has not changed is his extraordinary commitment to our mission. I can say with confidence that OpenAI would not exist without Greg, and I believe the world would be on a much worse path toward the AI future without him.

People should always be in control of the future.

OpenAI is against the notion that it would be acceptable for people to be relegated to a role of doing things that “AI systems think makes sense to reward in humans”.

People should not cede control of the future to superintelligence, and that requirement should ultimately constrain AI progress.
